components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action in a cluster: Renderizar, Criar projeto, Novo projeto.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); color: var(--color-signal-ink, #1a0610); border: 1px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font: 600 15px/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ff6e88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined Afterglow action when it is not the one primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); border: 1px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font: 600 15px/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-tape, #c4c9d6); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font: 600 15px/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-panel-2, #1b2130); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive outline: Excluir, Banir. Never a filled orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-cut, #ff6b4a); border: 1px solid var(--color-cut, #ff6b4a); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font: 600 15px/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cut, #ff6b4a) 12%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Bay well inside a panel. Labels sit in tape above the field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 0.85rem/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; color: var(--color-tape, #c4c9d6); } .ds-input { background: var(--color-bay, #0b0d12); color: var(--color-ink, #eef1f8); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #2c3345); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 15px/1.45 Outfit, sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-mute, #8b93a7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mast Navigation
components.description: Sticky 58px bar. Wordmark plus Projetos / Biblioteca. Active sits in a panel-2 well.

Memetize
ProjetosBiblioteca
components.css: .ds-mast { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 58px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--color-panel, #141822); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #2c3345); } .ds-wordmark { font: 700 1.5rem/1 Outfit, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink, #eef1f8); text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark span { color: var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; } .ds-nav a { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-mute, #8b93a7); font: 600 15px/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #eef1f8); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--color-ink, #eef1f8) !important; background: var(--color-panel-2, #1b2130); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Pipeline and asset status. Dot carries tone; the pill stays graphite.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 0.78rem/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #2c3345); color: var(--color-tape, #c4c9d6); background: var(--color-panel-2, #1b2130); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-mute, #8b93a7); } .ds-pill[data-tone="ok"]::before { background: var(--color-ok, #3dce8e); } .ds-pill[data-tone="busy"]::before { background: var(--color-signal, #ff4d6d); } .ds-pill[data-tone="bad"] { border-color: var(--color-cut, #ff6b4a); color: var(--color-ink, #eef1f8); } .ds-pill[data-tone="bad"]::before { background: var(--color-cut, #ff6b4a); }

components.name: 9:16 Screen
components.description: The object of work. Well fill, 12px corners, 1px rule. Storyboard and render share this frame.
components.css: .ds-screen { width: 180px; aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; background: var(--well, #07080c); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #2c3345); overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-screen-empty { color: var(--color-mute, #8b93a7); font: 400 0.85rem/1.45 Outfit, sans-serif; text-align: center; padding: 16px; }

narrative.overview:
Studio is a night bay: cool graphite, dense but quiet, one coral mark for where you are. You sit in it to review a planned cut, not to decorate a room. The surface is the work — a 9:16 screen, a strip, a playhead — and the chrome stays off that object.

Personality is calm, precise, technical. Outfit carries every label in Portuguese. IBM Plex Mono is reserved for time, versions, and ids. Numbers appear when they earn their place. There is no performance around the cut.

This system explicitly rejects Premiere and DaVinci Resolve's professional cockpit of four hundred panels. Steal the strip and the clock from Resolve; do not steal the rest of the room.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite bay, not cinema black and not SaaS navy
Afterglow coral used as a mark, never as a wash
One strip, one clock; preview and playhead agree
1px rules for depth; no drop shadows
Outline until the one primary fills

rules.name: The Afterglow Rule
rules.body: Afterglow coral occupies ≤10% of any screen. It is the playhead, the filled primary, the selected clip ring, and the focus outline. If a panel is tinted coral, the mark is spent.

rules.name: The Narrative is Data Rule
rules.body: Setup, escalation, payoff, and other color clip bars and the legend only. They are never buttons, never wordmarks, never backgrounds.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Body and labels that must be read sit on ink or tape. Mute is for idle chrome. If a sentence is mute-on-bay, bump it to tape.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Outfit never carries a timecode. IBM Plex Mono never carries a heading, a button, or a paragraph.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section titles are sentence-case Outfit at 1.05rem in tape. Forbidden: tiny uppercase tracked kickers above every block.

rules.name: The Rule Rule
rules.body: Every edge is 1px solid rule. Hover may shift a card's border to Afterglow coral. No 2px+ side stripes. No ambient umbra.

rules.name: The Well Rule
rules.body: Media lives in well: the 9:16 screen, the strip track, empty thumbs. Panels never sit in the well; the well never becomes a card.

dos: Do keep Afterglow coral for the playhead, the one filled primary, selection, and focus (2px / 2px offset).
Do stack graphite as bay → panel → panel-2, and drop media into the well.
Do draw every edge with a 1px rule line.
Do put time, versions, and ids in IBM Plex Mono; everything else in Outfit.
Do keep one strip and one clock. Preview and playhead must agree about what you are watching.
Do write every label, empty state, error, and toast in Portuguese.
Do kill animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do use narrative hues only on clip bars and the legend.
donts: Don't build Premiere and DaVinci Resolve's professional cockpit of four hundred panels.
Don't steal the rest of the room from Resolve — steal the strip and the clock only.
Don't use drop shadows, including 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) on dialogs or toasts.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide soft shadow.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe (toasts, quotes, selected rows).
Don't wash a panel, page, or card in Afterglow coral.
Don't use narrative-function colors as brand, buttons, or wordmarks.
Don't set body copy in mute on bay.
Don't round surfaces past 12px (the screen). Controls stay at 8px; pills are the only full-round shape.
Don't introduce a second display font, gradient text, or glassmorphism.
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrows above sections.
Don't animate layout or choreograph page load. Motion is state (busy pulse, toast rise, 150ms border) or it is nothing.
